system.description:
Ward Three — five armed investigators

Newly transformed Hausmann: grey mottled skin, black pupils, fangs, torn charcoal suit and gold left wristwatch. He has clawed Graf and killed an intern. Use this combat form rather than the earlier Feral Banker.

Using the Combat tab

Claws and bite are embedded weapons; their Roll buttons supply current STR plus Brawl 4. At full STR 7 the base pool is 11. For Blood Frenzy, set the roll dialog’s Modifier to +2 only against a target carrying Physical Damage, producing 13 at full strength. Do not add Brawl again or put Frenzy into Gear Bonus. Force is 11, Sneak 8 and Investigate 5 at the starting attributes. All six special abilities have their complete rules on the Combat tab; click a name to open its item.

Damage and initiative

Reduce current STR by resolved Physical Damage using the sheet’s Strength field; STR is a number, not a separate Health track. Attack pools recalculate from the reduced value. At STR 0 mark Broken; he cannot attack or use Feral Surge. The actor damage helper does not automate NPC damage. Resistance, feeding restrictions, Fear escalation, UV damage and the second initiative activation are adjudicated using the ability text. Do not add a second actor or token for the extra activation.

Tactics and escape

Telegraph the scrape and silhouette before normal awareness, Fear and initiative. He focuses on exposed wounded people. Investigators can interpose, evacuate Graf into the southeast theatre, concentrate fire or restrain him. Ordinary lights reveal his actual position but do not deal UV damage.

BM04 has northwest stairs and a northeast lift. The middle northern patient room is 3.14 with the exterior window. At STR 3 or lower, or if victims are sealed away, he tries that route. Telegraph the intent and spend actions to reach, break and pass through the window. Interception, restraint and lethal injury are honored. No forced escape, regeneration or claw-transmitted infection. With fewer than five investigators entering the fight, omit Feral Surge before initiative and record the chosen version.
system.secret: Hausmann received one phial as cancer treatment. He did not consent to becoming a vampire.
system.goal: Feed while blood is exposed; escape into the night once hurt or denied victims.
system.positiveResult: The cell kills or contains him, or denies his victims and forces an interceptable escape attempt.
system.negativeResult: He injures exposed investigators and may escape through room 3.14 if the route is open.
system.dissolutionMethod: No regeneration or reconstitution. Resolve Broken and lethal injuries normally.
system.artifactConnection: One phial administered by Dr. Graf; eleven remained in Corvi’s case at her last witnessed count.

system.description: Slow Action; engaged range; base Physical Damage 2. Roll uses current STR + Brawl 4 (11 at full strength). Set Modifier +2 for Blood Frenzy only against a physically wounded target. Additional successes use normal stunts. Grapple, shove or disarm replaces damage unless a normal stunt explicitly permits otherwise. Available on either Feral Surge activation.

Main activation Slow Action only; engaged range; base Physical Damage 3. Requires a grapple already held from an earlier action. Roll uses current STR + Brawl 4 (11 at full strength); set Modifier +2 for Blood Frenzy only against a physically wounded target. Normal defense and armor apply. No bite during the extra activation, free grapple, healing or automatic infection.

system.effect: Against a target currently carrying Physical Damage, add +2 to the roll dialog’s Modifier for a Brawl attack or grapple. The sheet already includes current STR + Brawl 4: the starting pool is 11, or 13 with this modifier. Apply once, not as Gear Bonus, and never against an uninjured target or a decorative bloodstain. This conditional bonus is recorded on the talent but must be selected manually; opening the item does not toggle it.

system.effect: Resolve normal Armor 2, then halve remaining ballistic Physical Damage, rounding up. A successful brainstem called shot under the normal targeting procedure bypasses halving, not armor. No resistance to melee, fire or other damage types. Manual adjudication.

system.effect: Solo encounter rule for five armed investigators. Draw two initiative cards for this one actor. First activation: normal action allowance. Second: one Slow Action only, for claws, grapple, shove, disarm or movement up to one zone. No bite or extra Fast Action. At most two attacks per round. Share all position, damage and conditions; restrictions affect both slots. No activation while Broken. Record the second card manually if necessary; never add another token.

system.effect: Move on solid walls and ceilings using normal movement actions and distance. No free movement, disengagement, automatic concealment or teleportation. Grapples and barriers still apply. Telegraph with scraping and an observable position.

system.effect: Direct sunlight or focused UV causes 2 unsoakable Physical Damage per round of actual exposure, once per round across both activations. Ordinary fluorescent lamps and flashes cause no damage. No spontaneous daylight in the nighttime encounter.

system.effect: Fear 2; escalate to 3 when the first bite visibly feeds, using normal Fear timing rather than a new check every activation. Bite grants no healing or automatic infection. At current STR 3 or lower, or with victims sealed away, prioritize the room 3.14 window. Breaking glass and escape require actions and permit interception. No regeneration or reconstitution.
